_om: Engelsk översättning av fallor.json. Bara texter; siffrorna står i den svenska filen. Fällorna kopplas ihop med sina id:n.

texter: A screech above you, and a grate of spiked iron bars crashes down in the doorway behind you. It takes time to prise it open.
The grate slams down. The bars curve inwards and are almost sharp at the tips. You are stuck for a while.
andra: Iron strikes stone somewhere in the {region} part of the tower.

texter: The floor gives way beneath you. You fall into the cellar vaults, where it is dark, damp and cramped.
The flagstones sink as if they were soft, and you slide down through a hole in the floor. Below there is nothing but dark, narrow vaults.
andra: A dull crash in the {region} part of the tower. Then silence. {namn} is no longer to be seen.
andra_dolt: A dull crash in the {region} part of the tower. Then silence.

texter: The room begins to turn with a slow, grinding sound. You lose your footing and are pushed out through an opening.
The walls draw together and twist. When it is over, you are somewhere else.
andra: A grinding sound in the {region} part of the tower.

texter: A click underfoot. Arrows whistle out of small holes in the wall. Two of them strike.
Arrows shoot out of the wall. They are not wood but something bone-white and curved.
A yellow-green mist wells up from the cracks in the floor. It smells sweet and burns the lungs. The poison stays in the body.
The mist is warm and damp, like a breath. You cough, and the bitter taste lingers long after.
You step into a pit full of small snakes. They bite and coil round your ankles before you get free.
The pit teems with snakes, thin as worms. They bite, and it takes time to climb out.
andra: A hissing in the {region} part of the tower, as of a hundred small snakes.

texter: A vast, translucent skin hangs across the room like a sail. You get tangled in it. The scales rustle against each other.
A shed snakeskin, so large it fills the whole room. It clings to you and you must tear yourself free.
You knock against a great bell hanging from the ceiling. The toll runs through the whole tower, and through the slits you see the sun sink swiftly.
A bell tolls by itself as you step in. The light outside turns redder at once.
andra: A bell tolls somewhere in the tower. The light through the slits turns redder. The sun sinks faster.

texter: A warm gust passes through the room and your lantern goes out. You see nothing. You must grope your way.
Something breathes out, and your flame flutters and dies. The darkness is complete.
Your step echoes, and the echo goes on and grows until the whole tower rings. Now everyone knows where you are.
The room catches every sound and throws it out into the passages. Everyone in the tower hears where you stand.
andra: An echo rolls through the tower. {namn} is in {rum}, in the {region} part of the tower.

skatt: Under a loose stone lie a few coins. {antal} gold. You now have {skatt}.
Something glints in a crack in the wall. {antal} gold, a little sticky. You now have {skatt}.
dryck: Behind a shelf you find a small flask of red potion. It heals wounds.
A whole flask, still sealed. You put it in your bag.
gang: You press a stone and it gives. A secret passage opens to the {riktning}.
Behind a curtain of dust is a narrow opening to the {riktning}. Its edges are soft.
gang_ingen: You find the traces of a secret passage, but it leads nowhere.
falla: You search too thoroughly and set something off.
inget: You search for a long time but find nothing.
Dust, dirt and a couple of old buttons. Nothing of value.
redan: This room has already been searched.
inte_har: There is nothing to search here.

skada: You lose {skada} of your lives. You have {liv} left.
dod: Everything goes black. The tower has taken you.
dod_andra: A scream rings out and dies away. {namn} is dead.
fast: You are stuck and cannot go on.
kallare: You grope your way through the cellar vaults. They are cramped and the walls are soft.
The cellar vaults wind in every direction. You search for a way up.
kallare_ut: You find a stair and climb up out of the cellar vaults. You are in {rum}.
kallare_ut_andra: {namn} climbs up out of a hole in the floor in the {region} part of the tower.
kallare_ut_andra_dolt: Something scrapes beneath the floor in the {region} part of the tower, and a hatch slams shut.
morker_nytt: You grope your way into a room you cannot see.
morker_slut: You get the lantern lit again. The light seems weak.
gift: The poison burns. You lose 1 life and have {liv} left.
gift_slut: The poison has left your body.
drick: You drink. Warmth spreads and the wounds draw together. You are up to {liv} lives.
drick_gift: The potion drives out the poison.
